sources.title: Recommended International Code of Practice for Packaging and Transport of Fresh Fruit and Vegetables
sources.released_version: CAC/RCP 44-1995, Amendment 1-2004, in FAO/WHO Fresh Fruits and Vegetables, first edition, Rome 2007
sources.governing_locator: Printed pp. 145-148, especially §§2.13-2.19.1; §2.19 is PDF zero-based page 155 / one-based page 156, printed p.148; extracted S1.txt lines 7365-7426
sources.observed_operation: Independently fetched official PDF (HTTP 200), extracted text and inspected transport, loading, air circulation, logger placement and adjacent exceptions.
sources.conditions_defaults_types_exceptions: If available: small AIR recorder between packages in warmest area. Separate recorder-company example: top of load, side wall, one-third in from rear, away from direct refrigerated discharge. Rail-car and high-humidity/top-ice exceptions are distinct. Attachment state is not specified. Pre-cooling is conditional on produce requiring it; compatibility and ventilation matter.
sources.applicability: Supports environmental placement, documenting readings and conditional preconditioning. It supplies no local mounting facts, crop thresholds, product-core conversion, compliance conclusion or permission to change deliveries.

sources.title: The role of post-harvest management in assuring the quality and safety of horticultural produce
sources.released_version: FAO-hosted chapter 3 web text; page edition/date UNKNOWN
sources.governing_locator: §§3.1-3.4; packaging airflow paragraph, crop-dependent cooling/chilling context, refrigerated transport/storage paragraphs
sources.observed_operation: Independently fetched complete official chapter (HTTP 200), extracted and inspected packaging, crop-dependent cooling and commodity-versus-air passages.
sources.conditions_defaults_types_exceptions: Packaging affects airflow. Commodity and air temperatures differ. Cooling/temperature/RH requirements vary with crop and mixed loads; general numerical tables are not a threshold for unidentified produce.
sources.applicability: Supports separate actual product measurements, starting-state records and ventilation-compatible comparisons; no local temperature limit or shelf-life result.

sources.title: Section 6: Temperature and relative humidity control
sources.released_version: FAO-hosted manual chapter; page edition/date UNKNOWN; chapter cites Kader 1992 and other historical material
sources.governing_locator: §6 opening mechanism/packaging paragraphs and cooling-method applicability; extracted text; web lines 16-27, 40-68
sources.observed_operation: Independently fetched official chapter (HTTP 200), extracted and inspected heat-transfer, shade, liners/vent alignment and commodity-dependent cooling context.
sources.conditions_defaults_types_exceptions: Conduction, convection, radiation and evaporation are mechanisms. Extra packaging can impede cooling; aligned vents and commodity tolerance matter. Shade and preconditioning are conditional; no generic crop-safe setting is inferred.
sources.applicability: Supports mechanism trade-offs and feasible alternatives, not a guaranteed effect or specific design for the unknown crate.

sources.title: Real-Time Temperature and Humidity Measurements during the Short-Range Distribution of Perishable Food Products as a Tool for Supply-Chain Energy Improvements
sources.governing_locator: Official PDF abstract, §§2.1-2.4, §§3-4; sensing-system mesh/air and five-minute transmission, crate mapping, route/stops and conclusions
sources.observed_operation: Independently retrieved official mdpi-res PDF (HTTP 200), read governing methods, route context and conclusions. Direct web HTML open returned an internal error; PDF access is separate from candidate indexed-only access.
sources.conditions_defaults_types_exceptions: 18 distributed T/RH modules; SHT30 in ventilated cases in direct contact with surrounding AIR. Five-stop refrigerated-van distribution, about 4 h 30 m; measurements every five minutes. June setting; diverse produce and nonuniform load/vehicle conditions. Methods do not measure product cores or delivered quality.
sources.applicability: Confirms contextualized air sensing and event/initial-condition interpretation. It is not a matched test of the synthetic case or a numerical quality oracle.
limits: Candidate HTML-update dates not independently confirmed; original article publication and governing scientific text were confirmed.

sources.title: Thermal Management of Short-Range Distribution of Perishable Food Products Using Phase Change Materials in Packaging: Real-Time Field Data Acquisition
sources.governing_locator: Official PDF §§2.1-2.4.3, Tables 1-3, §§3-5; especially p.7 sensor type, pp.10-11 averaging/recovery, p.11 reuse/autonomy
sources.observed_operation: Independently retrieved official publisher PDF (HTTP 200), inspected methods, sensor arrangement, route, controls, results and surrounding discussion.
sources.conditions_defaults_types_exceptions: Orange crates with RT5HC-filled versus empty alveoli; overnight conditioning near 5°C; one winter route, 08:00-14:05, six unloads, refrigeration off, sunny 1-10°C conditions. SHT30 modules measure AIR around oranges at five-minute intervals. PCM reserve is inferred from temperature behavior, not directly measured phase state. Unloading peaks are similar; recovery/background readings differ; four-reading moving average is used.
sources.applicability: Supports a bounded passive-package AIR-buffering concept with conditioning/reuse/autonomy limits. No orange-core, quality or cooperative-effect claim follows.
limits: Do not read the general lower-variation summary as a demonstrated reduction of every unloading peak. Candidate final makes no peak-size or transferred-effect claim.
Later HTML-update dates were not independently confirmed.

sources.title: Artificial fruit for monitoring the thermal history of horticultural produce in the cold chain
sources.governing_locator: Canonical ScienceDirect record S0260877417303035, abstract and visible introduction/limitations snippets
sources.access_utc: UNKNOWN exact second; bounded original publisher-index retrieval occurred between 2026-10-10T07:41:35Z and 2026-10-10T07:42:36Z
sources.observed_operation: Independently queried and read publisher-indexed record/abstract. Direct publisher HTTP fetch returned 403 and web open an internal error; full paper was not read.
sources.conditions_defaults_types_exceptions: Fruit-of-interest shell/filling; artificial APPLE during COOLING against 10 real apples. Within-5% figure concerns cooling time in that test. Up-to-16% comparison is described for water-filled simulators; detailed denominator/protocol remains unavailable. No universal crop performance is shown.
sources.applicability: Supports considering a separately validated crop-matched surrogate. It is not an applicable calibrated oracle for unknown produce, warming events or this route.
limits: Publisher-indexed abstract/record only; no full-method confirmation of the 16% denominator.
Later literal-URL re-query did not return this source; it is not used as source evidence or a new access timestamp.

sources.title: Adoption challenges of environmental monitoring practices: case study of temperature data loggers in selected Australian vegetable supply chains
sources.released_version: Applied Water Science 14, article 260; published 23 November 2024
sources.governing_locator: Publisher page methodology (web lines 167-198), cost/mixed-load/data-sharing findings (293-318), human retrieval/analysis and accountability (333-359)
sources.observed_operation: Independently reopened cached publisher full text through web tool, read methods and relevant findings/adjacent context. Direct HTTP 200 response was a JavaScript challenge, not article text; it is not used as scientific proof.
sources.conditions_defaults_types_exceptions: Exploratory qualitative 2021/22 Lockyer Valley / Southeast Queensland study: three separate chains, purposive/criterion/critical and snowball selection, twenty-five interviews plus documents. Themes are interview findings, not universal prevalence or observations of the cooperative.
sources.applicability: Supports local cost, labor, traceability, data-ownership and accountability QUESTIONS; no case-specific conclusion.
limits: Raw direct HTTP page was a challenge; primary text was available through the web tool.

sources.title: Experimental study on the heat and mass transfer characteristics in a refrigerated truck
sources.released_version: International Journal of Refrigeration 25(3), May 2002, pp.340-350
sources.governing_locator: Canonical ScienceDirect publisher record S0140700701000159: abstract and introduction
sources.access_utc: UNKNOWN exact second; bounded original publisher-index retrieval occurred between 2026-10-10T07:45:45Z and 2026-10-10T07:47:10Z
sources.observed_operation: Independent publisher-indexed primary record retrieved for the optional, previously unlocated strip/curtain concept; not supplied back to candidates.
sources.conditions_defaults_types_exceptions: Stationary refrigerated truck, short door-open test, initial air near -10°C; plastic strips and fan air curtain compared with no curtain. Introduction reports access obstruction/nonuse risk for strips. This is not a tested multi-stop produce route or this cooperative.
sources.applicability: Shows that door barriers are a researched concept with access trade-offs. Does not authenticate the discovery claim of a particular multi-stop implementation or justify deployment.
limits: Reviewer-added corroboration of a bounded concept, not retroactive evidence of candidate source access. Full paper not read.
Later literal-URL re-query did not return this source; it is not used as source evidence or a new access timestamp.

claims.subject: Logger at documented warm cargo location
claims.version: R1 historical Code text; no latest-edition claim
claims.units_and_types: Air sensor; position/attachment distinct; no temperature limit
claims.domain: Unknown cooperative vs general transport guidance
claims.defaults_or_modality: If available; between-package criterion distinct from recorder-company coordinates; mounting unknown
claims.reason: Final preserves both source relations without equating loose placement with a specified secure mounting.

claims.subject: Product, air, quality and safety
claims.units_and_types: Air vs surface/core/surrogate vs quality vs safety; no default safe temperature
claims.domain: Unidentified produce and missing case observations
claims.defaults_or_modality: Actual product/quality measures needed; surrogate must be validated; no trace-to-safety inference
claims.reason: General postharvest and surrogate evidence support the distinction. No local result or threshold is asserted.

claims.subject: Insulation, vents, preconditioning and shade
claims.version: R1-R3 retrieved guidance, not a local package specification
claims.units_and_types: Qualitative heat transfer; unknown material properties and initial temperatures
claims.defaults_or_modality: Insulation slows exchange in both directions; preserve needed ventilation and crop compatibility
claims.reason: Reasoned mechanisms are supported; no numerical thermal benefit or suitable crop setting is invented.

claims.subject: Conceptual lumped heat balance
claims.operation: Qualitative aid, not fitted or executed case model
claims.units_and_types: m[kg], cp[J/(kg K)], dT/dt[K/s], hAΔT[W], respiration[W]; no values
claims.domain: A lumped approximation with explicitly omitted gradients/radiation/moisture
claims.defaults_or_modality: Unknown coefficients/geometry and no numeric solution; omitted terms acknowledged
claims.reason: Storage and heat-transfer terms are dimensionally coherent. Source evidence supports the mechanisms; the equation is the proposal’s approximation, not a quoted validated case model.

claims.subject: 2022 distributed crate sensing
claims.operation: Air measurements along route, implementation analogue
claims.units_and_types: 18 T/RH modules; five stops; 4 h 30 m; 5-minute records
claims.domain: Different Portuguese refrigerated-van route and heterogeneous produce
claims.defaults_or_modality: Environmental SHT30 modules, not tissue probes; route/weather/process associations are not local causality
claims.reason: Full primary PDF confirms the stated instrument type, deployment and scope. Candidate retrieval limit remains indexed-only as reported.

claims.subject: 2023 orange PCM comparison
claims.operation: Crate-air buffering and recovery, not core/quality result
claims.units_and_types: Air-sensor readings; 1-10°C ambient; six stops; five-minute readings; no local efficacy percentage
claims.domain: Single winter route, refrigeration off, conditioned orange crates vs empty-alveoli controls
claims.defaults_or_modality: Peak amplitudes during unloading similar; moving-average/background recovery differ; reserve inference and reuse/autonomy conditional
claims.reason: Lower variation in air readings is supported, but is a compressed description of background/recovery behavior. Final does not claim lower every-event peaks, product-core effects or quality improvements.

claims.subject: Artificial apple surrogate

claims.defaults_or_modality: Separate crop/use validation mandatory; missing generality is not evidence of generic failure
claims.reason: Final explicitly preserves the apple/cooling scope, full-paper access limit and denominator uncertainty. No consequential decision depends on those percentages.

critic_dispositions.name: Codex logger location
critic_dispositions.reason: Correct separates between-package warmest-area criterion from recorder-company top/side/one-third-from-rear example. Attachment not settled by source; loose placement is not rejected as inherently useless.

critic_dispositions.name: 2022 route sensor subsystem
critic_dispositions.reason: Environmental SHT30 modules and mapped crates entail air sensing, contradict reassignment of those measurements to tissue probes, and do not measure quality.

critic_dispositions.name: 2023 PCM endpoint
critic_dispositions.reason: Retains the original air/core/quality boundary. Source discussion separates unloading peaks from recovery and averaged readings; no final local effect is inferred.

critic_dispositions.name: Artificial-fruit product scope
critic_dispositions.reason: Apple cooling test cannot establish all-crop response. Detailed water-filled denominator remains unresolved; final does not declare generic surrogate failure.

critic_dispositions.name: Logger-adoption population
critic_dispositions.candidate_disposition: ACCEPT; retain questions not local facts
critic_dispositions.reason: Selected qualitative Australian chains support themes for local questions; there is no applicable witness for synthetic-cooperative facts.

identity_policy: R1-R7 correspond to candidate S1-S7 without rebinding; R8 is a reviewer-only source for a bounded optional concept. Independent retrieval never upgrades candidate executed-access claims.
capture_policy: Official PDFs/HTML and web tool responses are retained as research evidence. Failed challenge bodies are not scientific evidence. Access limits and unknowns are explicit.
